safety.descriptionHint: What happened, in your own words

family.subtitle: Involve the people whose judgement you trust.
family.inviteBody: A parent, sibling or guardian. They receive an invitation and create their own account - they never share yours, and they never see your password.
family.permissionsBody: Each permission is granted one at a time and can be taken back instantly. Nobody sees your contact details, your exact location, or anything you have not shared with them.
family.reviewTitle: They approve before anyone can talk
family.reviewBody: If you choose it, a match waits for their approval before a conversation can begin. You can change the setting or remove them whenever you want - what you cannot do is approve on their behalf, because that is what makes the approval mean something.
family.privacyNote: Everything a family member looks at is recorded and shown to you.
family.gateBody: When this is on, a new match cannot become a conversation until someone you trust approves it. You can turn it off again at any time. What you cannot do is approve your own match — that is what makes the approval mean something.
family.gateNoReviewers: Nobody can approve yet. Invite someone and give them the approval permission, or every new match will wait with no way to open it.
family.membersEmpty: You have not invited anyone yet.
family.revokeConfirm: Remove {{name}}? They lose every permission immediately. Any review they were asked for stays pending, so nothing is approved or rejected on their way out.
family.inviteContactHint: They receive a link and create their own account.
family.tierObserverBody: They see what you have chosen to share, and nothing else.
family.tierReviewerBody: Everything above, plus they can approve or decline a match before a conversation starts, and report or block on your behalf.
family.inviteTokenOnce: Share this link with them now. For their safety it is shown once and cannot be retrieved later — if you lose it, cancel the invitation and send a new one.
family.reviewsEmpty: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
family.packetReported: This person has been reported before
family.packetNoContact: You are seeing what is needed to make this decision. Contact details, exact location and private messages are never shown to family.
family.myReviewStalled: This has been waiting more than 3 days. You can remove this family member or turn family review off — you do not need their agreement to do either.
family.accessLogNote: Every time someone you invited looks at something, it is recorded here with the permission that allowed it.
family.errorLoad: Could not load your family settings.
family.errorSave: That did not save. Please try again.

chat.subtitle: Conversations with the people you have matched with.
chat.emptyBody: When a match is open, your conversation appears here. If your family reviews matches, it begins after they approve.
chat.leaveConfirm: Leave this conversation? You will stop receiving messages. This does not end the match — you can do that from the match itself.
chat.closedPending_family_review: Waiting for family approval before this conversation can begin.
chat.closedFamily_rejected: Your family declined this match, so messages are closed.
chat.closedFamily_revoked: Family approval was withdrawn. You can still read what was said.
chat.closedBlocked: Messages are closed because of a block.
chat.closedMatch_ended: This match has ended. You can still read what was said.
chat.closedRead_only: You can read this conversation but not write in it.
chat.errorSend: That message did not send. Please try again.
